d:
Odisha is preparing for a possible third cyclone in three weeks, as a depression over the Bay of Bengal is expected to intensify into a cyclonic storm on November 16 and a severe cyclonic storm by November 17.
The India Meteorological Department has forecast scattered rainfall across coastal Odisha on November 18, with isolated heavy rainfall likely in several districts. The IMD has also advised fishermen along the south Odisha coast not to venture into the sea from November 18 to 21 and to return to shore immediately.
